skill.name: show-me

description.zh: 对话中的轻量可视化讲解：用伪代码、调用树、组件树、文件树、Mermaid、diff 或单页 HTML 里最小的形态把当前话题讲清楚，少文字、直击要点。
description.en: Concise in-conversation visual explanations: pseudocode, call trees, component trees, file trees, Mermaid, diffs, or a focused HTML artifact — always the smallest view that makes the point.

skill.usageExample: 别光用文字解释，画给我看：这个保存流程的缓存逻辑是怎么回事。
